text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the academy bustled with excitement
over the upcoming U.A.F.—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Auspicious direction, aligned with the dragon vein, and an auspicious hour, check.
—Alright, it should be right around here!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We sure have come a long way.
Wait, didn't you say we were going to practice
"Heimlich Shoot" today?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's why I want to neutralize the bad vibes once
so I can amplify the good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You know how the dirt tracks we usually run on are filled with the qi of the earth, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
However, the pool where we play "Hell Swim Shoot"
is Water—which stands in a relationship of mutual destruction
with Earth ki.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought I'd use the power of the trees to neutralize the earth's negative energy, and gather the power of the dragon veins on top of that!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Rickey, you're always going on
about feng shui this and feng shui that!
Come on, let's practice seriously."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is a serious field of study, you know?
Besides, Tarumae, you want to leave behind
great results at the U.A.F. too, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"That's exactly why I can't fool around here!
Results only come after steady, honest practice!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Tarumae-chan. Sure, coming
to the mountains was a big surprise, but—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hear "Hell's Swim Shoot" is all about stamina.
Why don't we take a leisurely stroll and think of it as building our leg strength?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky told me to soak up the Qi from the trees,
or something like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What's with this pile... so much junk...
A broken clock, golf clubs...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is this what they call illegal dumping? What a shame to ruin such a pretty view.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I cannot forgive this!
We ought to be grateful for such a rich environment
and protect it, yet—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"You can't just leave it all dirty!
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to pick up trash!
We have to restore this mountain to its former beauty!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Tarumae! Even in feng shui,
cleaning to purify the energy of a space is fundamental!
I'll help you out!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, who's a good pair of kids? There, there.
Oh, don't worry, if we all do it together,
it'll be done in no time~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Yesterday was a total disaster...
I have to make up for lost ground today—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Kick the water hard—and shoot!
Not done yet! Shoot! Shoot!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Huh?
Somehow... I feel really good today...?
No matter how much I move, I don't feel tired at all...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well my goodness, aren't you amazing, Tarumae-chan!
Looks like all that spring cleaning on the mountain really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see... We walked so much and even picked up trash, so our stamina improved!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I told you so!
This is the power of Feng Shui!
It's the result of neutralizing the bad energy and boosting the water qi!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Geez, I told you feng shui has nothing to do with it!
